blocks.title: Digital literacy
blocks.text: Digital literacy computers, smartphones aur internet jaise digital auzaar istemal kar ke maloomat dhoondne, samajhne, banane aur share karne ki salahiyat hai, jis mein talash, maakhaz ke motabar hone ki parakh aur zaati maloomat ki hifazat shamil hai.

Science project ke liye mawad jama karne wala student search engine se articles aur videos dhoondta hai, aur digital literacy use tay karne mein madad deti hai ke kaunse qabil-e-bharosa hain, jaise university ya maaruf idare ke.

blocks.prompt: Kya tez typing digital literacy ke liye kafi hai? Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Digital literacy mein maloomat ko mehfooz tareeqe se dhoondna, parakhna, banana aur share karna bhi shamil hai, sirf aala chalana nahi.

items: Digital literacy: digital auzaar se maloomat dhoondna, samajhna, banana aur share karna, mehfooz tareeqe se.
